Thanks Alex — appreciate the timing note. Ballpark pricing (very high level):

- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): $0.06 / 1K tokens (rough, depends on model mix).
- Dedicated (reserved pool): ~$12,000 / GPU-month for typical production throughput (saves ~35-50% on per-token at scale).
- Private / VPC: includes dedicated capacity + network isolation + KMS integration; one-time on-boarding (security review + network setup) and a modest infra configuration fee (I’ll include numbers in the formal proposal).

Typical lead times:
- Dedicated pool (provisioning): 1–2 weeks after contract.
- Private/VPC (security review + peering + KMS): 4–6 weeks end-to-end if security can prioritize the initial deep-dive.

I’ve attached a short proposal and the network checklist for your infra team (20260723-redwood-proposal.pdf, acme-network-requirements.xlsx). If you’re open, I can book a 60-min technical deep-dive next Tue/Wed with our Solutions Engineer to walk the VPC peering steps and KMS integration.
